name: Adam Armus
bio: WGA and Emmy award nominated television writer, Executive Producer and showrunner of many shows including Heroes, The Following, The Goldbergs, Quantico and Proven Innocent. Mr. Armus has also co-created, executive produced and showrun American Odyssey for NBC. His writing and producing credits include Zoey's Extraordinary Playlist, Heroes Reborn, The Practice and many other programs. He's written several TV movies and mini-series for the Hallmark Channel, animated shows, programs for foreign markets and pilots for many Hollywood studios.
